title: Spacetime Waymark
text: Alternatively, react 4 Spiritual Crystals with 1000 mB of Dilute Spacetime to obtain one waymark. No catalyst block is required.
Interact with a waymark to record its position and rename it; placing or passing it is not enough. Natural waymarks receive a Lost Point name using the first available number.
Waymarks need two blocks of height and a safe landing area. Destroyed waymarks can no longer be used.
